system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

Every shinobi arrives at a crossroad. The one that makes them choose a path of focus. The ones born into clans never have to make this choice. It was made for them as a result of their bloodline. But you aren’t one of them, you’ve speed unspoken time watching learning and determining which discipline is the one you will follow. Select one of the following Paths. This decision cannot be changed later.

Path of Ninshou

You’ve decided to focus on chakra molding and Ninjutsu.

Chakra Imprint. As a Bonus action on your turn, you can imprint a target creature within 60 feet of you with your chakra, until the end of your next turn. An imprinted creature, cannot make saving throws against jutsu you cast at advantage.

Chakra Anchor. When you deal damage to a creature, you can spend 2 Drive to restrain their presence. Until the end of your next turn, the affected creature cannot teleport or be moved by jutsu or feature based effects that does not spend their movement.

Path of the Fist

You’ve decided to focus on hardening your body, fists and feet.

Unrelenting Strikes. You unarmed attacks gain the Deadly 2 weapon property.

Combat Rhythm. When you deal damage to a creature with a Taijutsu you cast that doesn’t have either the Combo or Finisher keywords, you can spend 2 Drive to give the jutsu the Combo keyword.

Path of the Magician

You’ve decided to focus on breaking the minds of your foes.

Cold Illusion. Once per turn, when you score a hit with an attack against a creature, you can conjure an illusory doppelganger of yourself in any unoccupied space within 15 feet of you, has 10 AC, 1 Hit Point and lasts until the beginning of your next turn. While active and within 15 feet of you, the first time a hostile creature targets you, they must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your Genjutsu save DC. On a failure, they target the doppelganger instead.

Illusory Tools. As part of casting a Genjutsu, you can spend 2 Drive to conjure one illusory Explosive Tool or ranged weapon, throwing it at the same target, either making an attack if a weapon, or following the rules of the chosen tool if it forces a saving throw. If the tool deals damage, the damage becomes psychic damage.

Path of the Blade

You’ve decided that a sharp or sturdy weapon is your best tool.

Twisting Turn. Once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] to a hostile creature, you can make one additional attack using a Kunai, Shuriken or Senbon. If you score a hit with this attack, you force the target creature to make a Dexterity saving throw vs your Taijutsu save DC. On a failure, they gain a rank of Bruised until the end of your next turn.

Chain Break. As part of Casting a Bukijutsu with the Chain keyword, by spending 2 Drive, you can select which chain rank you want to use. Once you use this ability, you cannot benefit from the chain effect of a Bukijutsu you cast, until the end of your next turn. You can still sustain a chain as normal.

Universal Path

You’ve decided that dedicating yourself to a strict path is foolish. You choose to be flexible instead of rigid.

Self-Mastery. For every jutsu you cast beyond the first one cast on a turn, with a casting discipline keyword different from the previous jutsu cast this same turn, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage dealt, stacking up to three times.

Open Form. As part of Casting a Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu, you can spend 2 Drive. When you do, you can spend either your Bonus Action or Reaction to gain an additional Action, which can only be used to cast one of the remaining casting discipline jutsu. If you do, you can spend an additional 2 Drive, to spend the remaining Bonus action or Reaction to gain an additional Action to cast one of the remaining casting discipline jutsu that you have not cast this turn. These castings must target different creatures, unless there is a Solo Adversary in combat, in which case these castings must target that creature.
